500 GRID · CLARITY · MAKE THE COMPLEX SIMPLE
Clarity is the value of reduction: keeping what matters and letting the rest settle.
The 500 note starts with eight restless stripes. They calm, pair up, merge and arrive as a single bar, exactly
as tall as the number it carries. Nothing is removed; everything is resolved.
Eight stripes of equal thickness close their gaps in three stages: 8, 4, 2, 1.
Stripe thickness never changes, so the final bar is exactly 8 t: the numeral cap height.
Micro-grid cell 6, 12, 24 px then flat; stripe hatching 4, 8, 16 px then solid.
A travelling wave decays to zero before the first merge: noise becoming order.
Rail and window lines lose amplitude until they run straight and parallel.
FLAT-COLOUR SEPARATION · ONE PLATE PER ROLE

explicit colour layer; every pattern uses a colour from this palette only.
